title: satureja calamintha subsp. glandulosa
intro: Satureja calamintha subsp. glandulosa, commonly known as Glandular Calamint, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the mint family Lamiaceae. It is a shrubby perennial herb with fragrant leaves and pinkish-white flowers, native to the Mediterranean region. The health benefits of Glandular Calamint include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which may help to soothe digestive issues and reduce stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include volatile oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as calming the nervous system, relieving pain, and protecting against oxidative stress.
